label: Absolute pointing error (APE)
note: largest angle allowed between where the payload axis points and where it should point, at the level given

label: Absolute knowledge error (AKE)
note: largest error allowed in what the ADCS believes its attitude is, at the level given

label: Relative pointing error (RPE)
note: largest pointing wander allowed within a short window (jitter), at the level given

label: Pointing drift error (PDE)
note: largest slow pointing drift allowed over a long window (thermal, bias), at the level given

label: Rate stability
note: largest body rate allowed while holding a target, at the level given

label: Relative knowledge error (RKE)
note: largest error allowed in the attitude change the ADCS believes happened over a short window

label: Reference slew time
note: longest time allowed to turn through the reference slew angle (mission.sangle)

label: Settling time after a slew
note: longest time allowed after a slew before pointing is back within its requirement

label: Slews per orbit
note: fewest slews the ADCS must be able to make per orbit

label: Target-tracking rate
note: slowest rate at which the ADCS must be able to follow a moving target

label: Maximum body rate
note: lowest top body rate the ADCS must be able to reach

label: Detumble time
note: longest time allowed from separation, at mission.w0, to a slow stable spin

label: Sun-acquisition time in safe mode
note: longest time allowed in safe mode to point the panels at the Sun

label: Faults tolerated
note: fewest single failures the ADCS must survive and keep working

label: Recovery time after a single fault
note: longest time allowed to recover full service after one fault

label: Momentum saturation margin
note: fraction of the stored momentum left unused, 0 to 1

label: Momentum dump interval
note: shortest time allowed between momentum dumps

label: ADCS mass
note: heaviest the whole ADCS may be

label: ADCS orbit-average power
note: most power the ADCS may draw on average over an orbit

label: ADCS peak power
note: most power the ADCS may draw at any moment

label: ADCS volume
note: most volume the whole ADCS may take

label: RCS propellant per year
note: most thruster propellant the ADCS may use per year

label: Mission lifetime
note: how long the satellite must work in orbit

label: Launch epoch
note: years after J2000.0: 27.0 is early 2027

label: Fine-pointing duty cycle
note: fraction of the orbit in fine pointing, 0 to 1

label: Slews per day
note: slews per day

label: Reference slew angle
note: the slew angle the slew-time requirement is stated for

label: Initial tumble rate after separation
note: body rate just after separation from the launcher; give lo and hi if the launcher states a range

label: Altitude
note: mean altitude of a circular orbit

label: Inclination
note: orbit inclination; about 97 to 98 degrees for sun-synchronous orbits at a few hundred km

label: Eccentricity
note: orbit eccentricity; blank means circular, and the report lists it as assumed

label: LTAN
note: local time of the ascending node, hours

label: Satellite mass
note: the whole satellite, wet, at launch

label: Largest principal inertia
note: largest principal moment of inertia of the whole satellite

label: Intermediate principal inertia
note: middle principal moment of inertia

label: Smallest principal inertia
note: smallest principal moment of inertia

label: Centre-of-mass offset
note: centre-of-mass offset from the geometric centre

label: Inertia uncertainty
note: fraction, 0 to 1

label: Frontal area
note: area facing the direction of flight, in the attitude it flies most

label: Aerodynamic centre-of-pressure offset
note: distance between the centre of pressure for drag and the centre of mass

label: Sunlit area
note: area facing the Sun, in the attitude it flies most

label: Solar centre-of-pressure offset
note: distance between the centre of pressure for sunlight and the centre of mass

label: Surface reflectivity
note: fraction of sunlight the surfaces reflect, 0 to 1; blank takes the reference value, listed

label: Drag coefficient
note: drag coefficient; blank takes the reference value, listed

label: Residual dipole
note: the satellite's own magnetic dipole, from a magnetic test or a budget

label: Residual dipole uncertainty
note: how uncertain that residual dipole is

label: First flexible mode frequency
note: lowest structural or panel mode frequency; leave blank if the satellite is rigid

label: Modal participation
note: fraction, 0 to 1

label: Power allocated to the ADCS
note: power the platform can give the ADCS

label: Mass allocated to the ADCS
note: mass the platform can give the ADCS

label: Volume allocated to the ADCS
note: volume the platform can give the ADCS

label: Bus voltage
note: voltage of the bus the ADCS is powered from

label: OBC data interfaces offered
note: OBC data interfaces offered to the ADCS

label: Cell area on +X_B
note: illuminated solar-cell area on the +X_B face (0 for none)

label: Cell area on -X_B
note: illuminated solar-cell area on the -X_B face (0 for none)

label: Cell area on +Y_B
note: illuminated solar-cell area on the +Y_B face (0 for none)

label: Cell area on -Y_B
note: illuminated solar-cell area on the -Y_B face (0 for none)

label: Cell area on +Z_B
note: illuminated solar-cell area on the +Z_B face (0 for none)

label: Cell area on -Z_B
note: illuminated solar-cell area on the -Z_B face (0 for none)

label: Array-to-bus efficiency
note: cell efficiency times power conversion

label: Battery capacity
note: usable battery energy

label: Platform load without the ADCS
note: orbit-average power the rest of the satellite draws

label: Battery state of charge at the start
note: 0 (empty) to 1 (full)

label: Thermal distortion contribution
note: pointing error from thermal distortion between the payload and the ADCS sensors, if known
